svg.title: Benzylic side-chain oxidation: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Benzylic oxygenated intermediates + oxidant → PhCHO / hydrated aldehyde-derived species. Successive oxidation raises the benzylic oxidation level; alcohol/aldehyde drawings denote functional-group stages rather than mandatory isolable intermediates.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Successive oxidation raises the benzylic oxidation level; alcohol/aldehyde drawings denote functional-group
stages rather than mandatory isolable intermediates.
